summary: Vitest now requires Node.js ^22.12.0 || ^24 || >=26 and Vite >=6.4.0 (Vitest 4 supported Node 20 and Vite 6.0)
vite is no longer a direct dependency of vitest, only a required peer dependency, so it must be installed by the project (package managers that skip peers, such as Yarn, need it in package.json)
clearMocks now defaults to true, so vi.clearAllMocks() runs before every test and mock call history no longer carries over between tests (set clearMocks: false for the old behavior)
testNamePattern / -t now matches the full name joined with ' > ' (as shown in reporters) instead of joining suite and test names with a single space
Inline project configs in test.projects now inherit the root config (extends defaults to true, including Vite plugins and resolve.alias, with arrays merged) instead of inheriting nothing

A config file referenced in test.projects that itself declares projects now contributes those nested projects instead of having its projects field silently ignored; projects is also removed from the inline ProjectConfig type

Inline projects that don't change Vite options now share the declaring config's Vite server (new sharedViteServer option, default true), so that config file and its plugins run once instead of once per project
vi.mock, vi.unmock and vi.hoisted called anywhere but the module top level (inside a function, block or describe/test callback) now throw instead of only logging a warning
In browser mode an automocked module (vi.mock without a factory) now returns auto-generated stubs (undefined) instead of still calling the real implementation

Instances of a class mock (vi.fn(Class), vi.spyOn on a class, mockImplementation(class ...)) now inherit the implementation's prototype methods and pass instanceof the original class; before, prototype methods were undefined on instances
bench is no longer a top-level export of vitest (nor bench.skip/only/todo); benchmarks use the bench fixture from the test context inside a regular test(), with await bench(name, fn).run()

benchmark.reporters, benchmark.outputFile, benchmark.compare, benchmark.outputJson and the --compare and --outputJson CLI flags are removed; benchmark output goes through the default and json reporters and baselines use writeResult/bench.from()
The Vitest instance's mode property is now always 'test'; the 'benchmark' value is no longer used
Vitest UI (and its API and coverage report pages) now require token authentication: /__vitest__/ errors until opened once with the ?token=... URL Vitest prints

vi.useFakeTimers() and vi.setSystemTime() (even without fake timers) now also fake Temporal when it is on the global object, so Temporal.Now follows the mocked clock instead of the real time; opt out with toNotFake: ['Temporal']
toThrow('') / toThrowError('') now matches any error message (substring semantics) instead of only an error with an empty message

Assertion and Matchers types now take the matcher return type first (Assertion<R, T>, Matchers<R, T>), so Assertion<string> becomes Assertion<void, string> and custom matcher declarations must be updated
Vitest no longer picks up custom matcher type declarations from the global jest.Matchers interface; they must augment vitest's Matchers
expect.poll now rejects when the callback or the polled assertion does not settle within timeout, instead of succeeding on a late result; the callback receives an AbortSignal
Unawaited asynchronous assertions (resolves, rejects, toMatchFileSnapshot) now fail the test instead of being auto-awaited at the end with a warning

Inspected values (assertion messages, test.each/test.for title interpolation) are now formatted with pretty-format instead of loupe, changing their rendering; title value truncation is controlled by the new taskTitleValueFormatTruncate option (default 40)
String values interpolated into test.each/test.for titles through a $ placeholder are no longer wrapped in quotes (case 'a1' becomes case a1)
test.sequential, describe.sequential and the sequential test option are removed (deprecated in 4.1); use { concurrent: false }
Locators passed to custom browser commands arrive as a SerializedLocator object ({ selector, locator }) instead of a bare selector string
browser.locators.exact now defaults to true, so text locators such as getByText require a full, case-sensitive match instead of a substring match
Browser-mode toHaveTextContent now requires the element's text to equal the string exactly and no longer accepts a RegExp; the old partial/regex matching moved to the new toMatchTextContent
Glob-pattern coverage thresholds no longer inherit the top-level thresholds.perFile setting; each glob must set perFile itself

coverage.include/exclude globs are now matched against paths relative to the project root without picomatch's contains option, and a pattern without wildcards matches a directory, so they match fewer files than before
Vitest no longer searches parent directories for a config file when run from a subdirectory; pass --config explicitly
In jsdom and happy-dom environments, assignments to globalThis/window properties (such as innerWidth) are now applied to the underlying DOM window instead of only shadowing it on the Node global
populateGlobal's returned originals map now holds property descriptors instead of plain values, so custom environments must restore them with Object.defineProperty
The browser orchestrator page is no longer served from a bare /__vitest_test__/ URL; it requires the sessionId query parameter Vitest generates
browser.api is deprecated and no longer has any effect; browser mode uses the top-level api option (default port still 63315)
The already deprecated browser.isolate option now prints a deprecation warning at startup (its value is still applied to top-level isolate)

Default artifact locations move under .vitest/: attachmentsDir (.vitest-attachements/ to .vitest/attachments/), browser failure screenshots (__screenshots__/ to .vitest/attachments/failure-screenshots/), blob reporter and --merge-reports (.vitest-reports/ to .vitest/blob/), html reporter (html/index.html to .vitest/index.html)
The json and junit reporters now write to .vitest/json/output.json and .vitest/junit/output.xml by default instead of printing to stdout (opt back in with the reporter's stdout option)
The html reporter's output option changed from outputFile (a file path) to outputDir (a directory)
toMatchScreenshot reference screenshots no longer follow browser.screenshotDirectory; they use the new browser.expect.toMatchScreenshot.screenshotDirectory option (default __screenshots__)
VITEST_POOL_ID, VITEST_WORKER_ID and TestModule diagnostic workerId now start at 1 instead of 0
resolveConfig from vitest/node no longer returns { vitestConfig, viteConfig }; it returns the resolved Vite config with the Vitest config on its test property, without creating a server
@vitest/runner (now inlined into vitest and no longer published with it) and @vitest/ws-client are deprecated packages

vitest no longer depends on @vitest/expect; its assertion code is bundled, so the standalone @vitest/expect package no longer shares state with Vitest's expect (use expect, expect.extend and chai from vitest)
@vitest/browser-webdriverio is no longer maintained in the Vitest repo; WebdriverIO support moved to a community package

The entry points deprecated in 4.1 are removed: vitest/coverage and vitest/reporters (use vitest/node), vitest/environments and vitest/snapshot (use vitest/runtime), vitest/runners and vitest/suite (use TestRunner from vitest), plus vitest/mocker and vitest/internal/module-runner
Browser mode no longer scales the tester iframe down to fit the UI, so page.screenshot and toMatchScreenshot capture at the configured viewport resolution
attachmentsDir is now a root-only option: every project writes attachments into the root config's directory and a per-project attachmentsDir is no longer used
vitest list and vitest.collect() now collect tests by static analysis by default instead of running the test files (pass --no-static-parse / staticParse: false for the old behavior)
experimental.fsModuleCache and experimental.fsModuleCachePath are deprecated (migrated with a warning) in favor of the top-level fsModuleCache and fsModuleCachePath options
The Vitest instance methods experimental_parseSpecifications and experimental_clearCache are deprecated aliases that log a warning; use parseSpecifications and clearCache
Setting deps.optimizer.web (the Vitest 3 alias for client, already ignored) now logs a deprecation warning pointing to deps.optimizer.client, unless a Vite environment named web exists
fsModuleCache is now enabled by default, so transformed modules are persisted on disk across runs (disable with fsModuleCache: false)

Browser mode now treats each browser instance as a worker: at most maxWorkers instances/pages are open at once across projects, so fewer browsers open by default than the previous projects x maxWorkers
